column2: Well... they're not bad people, and they took good care of me...{wait}{clear}It's just, I really can't... I can't explain it well...{wait}{clear}...Somehow it feels wrong, me being there.{wait}{clear}.........{wait}{clear}
Okay, I need to find somewhere to rest till morning. See you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
Huh? Oh, never mind. It's nothing much.{wait}{clear}
Okay, where should I rest till morning? See you.{wait}{clear}
I'm sorry, I don't have time right now.{wait}{clear}
That's kinda cold. Fine. I won't ask you for anything again.{wait}{clear}
No... that's a lie... Sis did that to Fein...?{wait}{clear}
Why... would they do this...?{wait}{clear}
A battle that drags in people who have nothing to do with it... it's too cruel... this is...{wait}{clear}
Let's stop the Empire.{n}
Don't give in to feelings now...{n}
Irene, don't give in to your feelings now. It's time to fight...{wait}{clear}
That's a horrible thing to say... People died...!{wait}{clear}
I'm human! I can't just act like nothing's wrong when so many people are hurt!{wait}{clear}
That kid who found Vesta for me... that family... we never found them... I hope they got away safe...{wait}{clear}This is... just horrible.{wait}{clear}
We must stop the Empire's invasion as soon as we can... Otherwise there will only be more people in grief.{wait}{clear}
Yeah... Otherwise tragedies like this will keep happening forever...{wait}{clear}
I'm sure they're all right. Let's believe they escaped.{wait}{clear}
Yeah... I hope so...{wait}{clear}They were such warm people... I want them to be alive...{wait}{clear}
Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Got a minute...?{wait}{clear}
There's something I want to ask you...{wait}{clear}
Answer me honestly.{wait}{clear}
Is my sister Serenis with the Empire?{wait}{clear}
Is she using a sorcerer's power to control the Empire and throw the world into chaos?{wait}{clear}
Answer me... please.{wait}{clear}
It is true that a woman named Serenis is with the Empire...{wait}{clear}But I don't know whether she is your sister, Irene...{wait}{clear}
Yes... Your sister is with the Empire now.{wait}{clear}
...So it's true.{wait}{clear}
Sis... why...?{wait}{clear}
...I have to stop her...{wait}{clear}
If it looks like she's going to show up, tell me.{wait}{clear}
Please.{wait}{clear}
Yes.{n}
I can't promise...{n}
It's a promise...{wait}{clear}
I can't promise that I'll always be able to...{wait}{clear}
Why not...? She's my sister!{wait}{clear}
Let me see her... no matter what...{wait}{clear}
No... I don't know whether a woman named Serenis is really with the Empire.{wait}{clear}
Really...? You're not lying to me, are you...?{wait}{clear}
I truly don't know, Irene.{wait}{clear}
Then if... if you ever find my sister, tell me...!{wait}{clear}
Hey, can we go back to the tower for a bit?{wait}{clear}
We've come this far, so we can stop by, right?{wait}{clear}
